title: Install config
description: A consumer project's record of installed catalog entries, stored as .agents/agentic-catalog.yaml in a repository or ~/.agents/agentic-catalog.yaml for a user and written by the browser's bulk install script.

revision.description: Catalog commit the files were fetched from.

scope.description: project installs into the repository the script ran in; user installs under the home folder for every project. Defaults to project.

skillsCli.description: Install catalog skills with the skills CLI (skills.sh) instead of copying files.

collections.description: Collections the selection started from; entries stays the source of truth.
